quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Mining & Smelting semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025): with a firm semiconductor market, sales volumes of carrier-attached ultra-thin copper foil and electrodeposited copper foil for high-frequency boards rose; Functional Materials sales rose 21.3% and segment ordinary profit 34.4% on higher copper foil volumes. Copper foil revenue was JPY 63,989 million against JPY 48,438 million a year earlier. Group operating profit rose 2.4% as copper foil volumes offset worse inventory effects from FX and metal prices; Metals ordinary profit fell 24.1% on worse overseas ore terms and inventory effects. On May 13, 2025 the company signed an agreement to transfer all shares of Mitsui Kinzoku ACT (automotive door locks) to Hi-Lex Corporation.
quarterly_data.figure: Copper foil revenue JPY 63,989 million (H1 FY2025: JPY 48,438 million); net sales 3,643 (100 million yen), +4.6%; operating profit 397, +2.4%; Functional Materials sales 1,505, +21.3%, ordinary profit 264, +34.4%; Metals ordinary profit 184, down 24.1%
